meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行审计代码库，发现漏洞并验证可利用性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对代码库进行深度安全审查并验证漏洞可利用性
copy.tagline_en: Audit codebases in parallel, find vulnerabilities and verify exploitability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need deep security review of codebases with exploitability validation

howto.what: 为代码做安全审计时,Claude 会组建一个 5 人虚拟团队:3 名猎人并行找漏洞,2 名工程师写小实验证明漏洞能否真被利用,再按可利用性定严重程度。最终产出一份报告,给出结论(通过/有问题/阻止)以及每个漏洞的位置、验证方法和修复建议。
howto.when: 当你说出「security-research」「security review」「vulnerability audit」等触发词,或要求做发布前检查、威胁模型验证等安全任务时触发。

say.text: 请对当前仓库做一次安全审查。
say.note: 会组建 5 人团队并行审计并产出报告。

say.text: 审计这个 PR 的改动,找找可利用的漏洞。
say.note: 会针对 diff 范围做漏洞与 PoC 验证。

say.text: 检查发布前的代码,验证威胁模型。
say.note: 触发发布前安全检查流程。

howto.what_en: For security audits, Claude forms a 5-member team (3 hunters, 2 PoC engineers) to find and verify vulnerabilities. Output is a report with a verdict (PASS / PASS WITH FINDINGS / BLOCK), findings, PoCs, fixes and residual risks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'security-research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', or ask for pre-release security checks or threat model validation.

say_en.text: Run a security review on the current repository.
say_en.note: Claude sets up the team and produces the report.

say_en.text: Audit this PR's diff for exploitable vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Hunters focus on changed files; PoCs verify them.

say_en.text: Check the pre-release code and validate the threat model.
say_en.note: Runs the pre-release security check workflow.
